components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt pill for the one primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gl-accent-fill, #1856ff); color: var(--gl-accent-on, #fff); font: 500 16px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--gl-elev-raised, 0 24px 80px rgba(79,140,255,0.18)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gl-accent-fill-hover, #1448e0); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--gl-focus-ring, 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,140,255,0.28)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gl-surface, rgba(255,255,255,0.74)); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid var(--gl-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.64)); color: var(--gl-fg, #102033); font: 500 16px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--gl-surface-hover, rgba(255,255,255,0.9)); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--gl-focus-ring, 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,140,255,0.28)); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Cobalt text action with a warm-glass hover wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--gl-accent-strong, #1856ff); font: 500 16px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--gl-surface-warm, rgba(238,246,255,0.72)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--gl-focus-ring, 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,140,255,0.28)); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Warm-glass field, 16px radius, Sky Glass border and halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--gl-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.64)); background: var(--gl-surface-warm, rgba(238,246,255,0.72)); color: var(--gl-fg, #102033); font: 400 16px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--gl-muted, #60708a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--gl-accent, #4f8cff); box-shadow: var(--gl-focus-ring, 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,140,255,0.28)); }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Glass toggle pill; Cobalt fill when on. Used for label and camera filters.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gl-surface, rgba(255,255,255,0.74)); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid var(--gl-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.64)); color: var(--gl-fg, #102033); font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-pill:hover { background: var(--gl-surface-hover, rgba(255,255,255,0.9)); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-pill[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--gl-accent-fill, #1856ff); color: var(--gl-accent-on, #fff); border-color: transparent; } .ds-pill-count { font-size: 12px; } .ds-pill[aria-pressed="false"] .ds-pill-count { color: var(--gl-muted, #60708a); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--gl-focus-ring, 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,140,255,0.28)); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Glass pill with a status dot; text uses the -text token, dot uses the fill token.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gl-surface, rgba(255,255,255,0.74)); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid var(--gl-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.64)); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--gl-fg-2, #34465f); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gl-muted, #60708a); } .ds-badge--success { color: var(--gl-success-text, #15803d); } .ds-badge--success .ds-badge-dot { background: var(--gl-success, #22c55e); }

Notifications

components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 4px; color: var(--gl-fg-2, #34465f); text-decoration: none; font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--gl-accent, #4f8cff); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--gl-fg, #102033); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--gl-focus-ring, 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,140,255,0.28)); }

narrative.overview:
Camera Events is the home's own glass, lit softly from behind. It should feel domestic and reassuring, never like a security console. Every surface is a frosted pane floating over a cool sky backdrop. Two blurred blue light pools sit behind the panes, so the blur always has something to catch, and each pane catches the light along a 1px white edge. When nothing is happening the app is calm and airy, and the camera footage is the only vivid thing on screen.

The system follows the open-source Open Design "Glassmorphism" system (`docs/design-system/glassmorphism/`, Apache-2.0) and adds its own dark theme. The light theme is a pale morning sky. The dark theme is the same porch at night: deep navy, not black, with dimmed light pools and pale-blue accent text, so opening an alert at 3 a.m. doesn't glare. Density is moderate, with generous radii, a 44px minimum touch target and whitespace before borders.

Components are light and tactile, glass you can press. Cards lift on hover, buttons drop 1px on press, and focus shows as a soft blue halo instead of an outline. Motion is quick and uses a single curve.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent panes with backdrop blur and saturate(140%), always edged with a white hairline.
A blue-tinted glow for elevation, never a grey drop shadow.
One sans family (Inter) with tight display tracking and relaxed body leading.
Light and dark are equal citizens. Dark is a full token override, not a filter.

rules.name: The Fill-Versus-Text Rule
rules.body: Fills and text never share a token. A status or accent colour has a fill token and a separate `-text` or `-strong` token, and each one gets a dark value.

rules.name: The No Raw Colour Rule
rules.body: Use only semantic utilities (`bg-card`, `text-fg-2`, `text-brand-strong`, `bg-success`, ...). Raw hex, Tailwind scale colours (`red-500`) and `dark:` variants are banned and are enforced by `src/styles.legacy-tokens.test.ts`. The one exception is chips that sit on top of camera footage (see Components).

rules.name: The Night Boundary Rule
rules.body: In dark mode every control boundary and focus indicator reaches 3:1 against what is behind it (WCAG 1.4.11). Controls use Control Edge and Control Well, never the glass hairline alone.

rules.name: The Literal Label Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case and short sentences, with no exclamation marks in the UI. Labels say exactly what happens ("Save changes", "Download clip").

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: Nest glass at most two levels deep: a pane, then a warm pane with the soft edge and no shadow. A third translucent layer makes contrast collapse.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Grey Rule
rules.body: Elevation in the light theme is a blue-tinted glow. Never use a neutral grey drop shadow.

dos: Do put every surface on a glass utility (`glass`, `glass-flat`, `glass-strong`, `glass-header`) so the blur, the edge and the fallback come together.
Do keep text contrast at least 4.5:1 against the pane and the worst-case backdrop behind it. If it gets busy, raise opacity or switch to `glass-strong`.
Do give every new colour primitive a `:root.dark` value, and split fill and text tokens.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px and show the focus halo on all of them.
Do keep one primary (Cobalt) action per view.
Do put element rules in `@layer base` and component classes in `@layer components`.
donts: Don't replace the white hairline edge with a grey border, or the blue glow with a grey shadow.
Don't stack more than two translucent layers.
Don't use Sky Glass for small text or white-on-blue labels. Use Cobalt.
Don't use raw hex, Tailwind scale colours or `dark:` variants (except chips over footage).
Don't add unlayered CSS to `src/styles.css`, because it overrides every utility.
Don't mix in other visual metaphors such as neumorphism or skeuomorphic textures, or put busy photos behind glass.
